meta.title: Gwada Pain001 a Burauzarku
meta.description: Ɗora ko liƙa bayanan biyan kuɗi na CSV ku ga tantancewa a aikace: IBAN mod-97, tsarin BIC, filayen dole, jimillolin sarrafawa da XSD na hukuma — duk a burauzarku.

text.Drop in a CSV, use the sample, or paste: Saka fayil ɗin CSV, yi amfani da samfurin, ko liƙa bayanan naku — tantancewa na gudana nan take, gaba ɗaya a cikin burauzarku, kuma babu abin da zai taɓa barin na'urarku.
text.How this validator helps you: Yadda wannan kayan tantancewa ke taimaka muku
text.<span class=\"tick\" aria-hidden=\"true\: ✓Gwada bayanan biyan kuɗi bisa gwaje-gwajen da bankuna ke amfani da su — filayen dole, lambobin tantance IBAN, tsarin BIC, jimillolin sarrafawa
✓Samar da ingantaccen fayil ɗin pain.001.001.09 canja wurin kuɗi wanda za ku iya bincika, kwafa, ko saukewa
✓Tabbatar da sakamakon bisa tsarin ISO 20022 na hukuma — XSD na asali, wanda ake tantancewa a cikin burauzarku
text.<strong>Nothing is uploaded.</strong> Yo: Ba a ɗora komai. Burauzarku ce ke karanta fayil ɗinku kuma ba ya taɓa barin na'urarku — babu sabar, babu ajiya, babu aiko da bayanai. Yana da aminci ga bayanai na gaske, amma amfani da bayanan gwaji da aka ɓoye shi ne al'ada mafi kyau.
text.<strong>Testing tool only.</strong> File: Kayan gwaji ne kawai. Ba a taɓa mika fayiloli don sarrafawa ba, kuma babu wani biyan kuɗi da zai iya faruwa sakamakon duk abin da kuka yi a nan.
text.<strong>Expected columns:</strong> <code: Ginshiƙan da ake tsammani: payment_id, payment_amount, currency, sunan mai biya da mai karɓa / IBAN / BIC, requested_execution_date — ana gane alamomin rabewa na waƙafi, waƙafi-da-ɗigo, da tab kai tsaye. Ku sauki samfuri a ƙasa don amfani da shi a matsayin abin koyi ga fitar da bayanan naku.
text.<strong>No charges.</strong> This tool,: Babu wani caji. Wannan kayan aiki, da cikakken jerin kayan aiki da ke bayansa, kyauta ne kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe.
text.\"Nothing is uploaded\" is a claim you c: "Ba a ɗora komai" magana ce da za ku iya gwada gaskiyarta cikin mintuna biyu:
text.Open DevTools&nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp;Network,: Buɗe DevTools → Network, sannan ku yi amfani da nunin. Buƙatun da ke akwai kawai su ne GET na asali ɗaya (same-origin) don kayan wannan shafi, injin WASM, da tsarin (schema) — babu ɗayansu da ke ɗauke da bayanan ku.
text.Run the XSD gate once, then switch DevTo: Gudanar da ƙofar XSD sau ɗaya, sannan ku mayar da DevTools zuwa Offline (ko kashe Wi-Fi). Dukan nunin — har da ƙofar tsarin hukuma — na ci gaba da aiki: wani service worker na adana komai bayan amfani na farko.
text.<a href=\"https://github.com/sebastienro: Wannan shafi ma buɗaɗɗen tushe ne — dabarar nunin modul ɗaya ne marar dogaro da wani abu, wanda za ku iya karantawa gaba ɗaya.
text.There is no analytics script, no error-r: Babu rubutun bin diddigi (analytics), babu sabis na rahoton kuskure, babu rubutun haruffa na wani ɓangare na uku, kuma babu wurin aika rahoton CSP — aika rahoto shi kansa haɗi ne zuwa waje.
text.<strong>Drag a CSV file here</strong> —: Ja fayil ɗin CSV zuwa nan — ko danna don bincika
text.Maximum 2&nbsp;MB · read locally by your: Iyaka 2 MB · burauzarku na karanta shi a na'urarku, ba a taɓa ɗorawa
text.Download a sample to use as your own tem: Ku sauki samfuri don amfani da shi a matsayin abin koyi naku: canja wurin kuɗi na SEPA · na ƙetare · rukunin layi 20
text.Validation result &amp; generated XML: Sakamakon tantancewa & XML da aka samar
text.Add data in step 1 — validation runs aut: Ƙara bayanai a mataki na 1 — tantancewa na gudana kai tsaye.
text.Validation findings by row and column: Sakamakon tantancewa bisa layi da ginshiƙi
text.Prove it against the official ISO 20022: Tabbatar da shi bisa XSD na ISO 20022 na hukuma
Matakai na 1–2 na gudanar da gwaje-gwaje masu sauri da aka rubuta da hannu. Wannan matakin na gudanar da ainihin abin: wani Python runtime (ta hanyar WebAssembly) yana aiwatar da xmlschema bisa tsarin pain.001.001.09 na hukuma — irin tantancewar da CLI ke yi. Ana kawo injin mai kusan 13 MB daga wannan shafin, kuma ana saukar da shi sau ɗaya, sa'ad da kuka nema (yana fara saukowa a hankali da zarar mataki na 2 ya samar da ingantaccen XML).
text.Run the official XSD gate&nbsp;&rsaquo;: Gudanar da ƙofar XSD ta hukuma ›
text.Generate XML in step 2 first — the XSD g: Da farko ku samar da XML a mataki na 2 — ƙofar XSD na tantance wannan fitowar ce.
text.Everything on this page runs in your bro: Duk abin da ke wannan shafi na gudana a cikin burauzarku — ba a ɗora, ba a adana, ba a aika komai ko'ina. Wannan nunin ya ƙunshi wani ɓangare na jerin aikin (filayen dole, IBAN mod-97, tsarin BIC, tsarin kuɗi da kwanan wata, jimillolin NbOfTxs/CtrlSum sarrafawa da aka sake lissafawa). Mataki na 3 na gudanar da ƙofar XSD ta hukuma a nan take ta WebAssembly. Kayan aikin da aka shigar na ƙara tantancewar JSON Schema da littattafan ƙa'ida guda biyar a kai — shigar da CLI don samun cikakken jerin aikin.
text.What this demo shows — and what the real: Abin da wannan nunin ke nunawa — da abin da ainihin jerin aikin ke ƙarawa
text.Each sample batch is also <a href=\"/sam: Kowane samfurin rukuni kuma ana iya saukar da shi a matsayin fayil ɗin CSV don amfani da shi a matsayin abin koyi ga fitar da bayanai daga ERP ko maƙunsar bayanai naku — layin kanun shi ne yarjejeniyar.
text.The demo above implements the <em>fail-f: Nunin da ke sama ya ƙunshi matakin gazawa-da-wuri na jerin aikin Pain001: gwajin filayen dole, lambobin tantance IBAN na ISO 13616 mod-97, tsarin BIC na ISO 9362, tsarin kuɗi da kwanan wata, da jimillolin sarrafawa (NbOfTxs, CtrlSum) da aka sake lissafawa daga bayanan maimakon a amince da su kawai. Gwada menu na "Saka kuskure…" — kowane yanayi na dasa kuskure guda ɗaya na gaske (lambar IBAN da aka juya, BIC mara kyau, ginshiƙin da ya ɓace, kuɗin da aka rubuta da waƙafin Turai, kwanan watan da ba zai yiwu ba) kuma ya nuna muku sakamakon layi-da-layi wanda ƙofar banki za ta ba da rahotonsa bayan kwanaki da dama.
text.The installed toolchain runs a much deep: Kayan aikin da aka shigar na gudanar da ƙofa mai zurfi sosai: tantancewar JSON Schema ga kowane bayani tare da daidaita sunayen filaye, littattafan ƙa'ida guda biyar (SEPA SCT, Instant, SDD Core, B2B, na ƙetare) tare da fitowar --explain ƙa'ida-bayan-ƙa'ida, da tantancewa ta ƙarshe na daftarin da aka samar bisa XSD na ISO 20022 na hukuma kafin a rubuta ko da baiti ɗaya. Ana goyon bayan nau'ikan pain.001 guda goma da pain.008.001.02.
text.Step 3 above is not a simulation: it boo: Mataki na 3 da ke sama ba kwaikwayo ba ne: yana kunna Python runtime a cikin WebAssembly kuma yana gudanar da xmlschema bisa tsarin pain.001.001.09 na hukuma, wanda ake kawowa daga wannan shafin — irin ƙofar XSD da CLI ke amfani da ita. Abin da ya rage na CLI kawai shi ne sauran jerin aikin: daidaitawar JSON Schema, littattafan ƙa'ida guda biyar tare da --explain, da sauran ma'anonin saƙo guda goma.
